supported.decision_mirror: hash-chained supervisor-visible record of substantive decisions/actions
supported.supervisor_relay: every mirrored decision exported to a durable outbox pending hosted transport
supported.relay_backpressure: blocks new entries when unacknowledged supervisor evidence exceeds hard limit
supported.signed_supervisor_ack: HMAC-SHA256 receipt required before delivery cursor advances
supported.operator_dashboard: read-only integrity-verified control surface; no mutation or execution endpoints
supported.dashboard_snapshot_integrity: SHA-256 snapshot sidecar verified in the browser before rendering operational state
supported.dashboard_server: local-only by default with CSP/security headers and GET/HEAD-only static serving

not_supported: exchange-grade 24x7 deployment until durable host/state is connected
direct automatic ChatGPT delivery until a durable hosted supervisor bridge is connected and acknowledged
